For Q1 fiscal 2025 (quarter ended December 28, 2024), Disney's diluted EPS excluding certain items — its non-GAAP "adjusted EPS" — was **$1.76**, up **44%** from $1.22 in the prior-year quarter (Q1 FY2024, ended December 30, 2023).

Context from the reconciliation (page 18):

| | Q1 FY25 | Q1 FY24 |
|---|---|---|
| Diluted EPS, as reported | $1.40 | $1.04 |
| Excluded: Star India restructuring & impairment charges | +$0.20 | — |
| Excluded: TFCF/Hulu intangible amortization & fair value step-up | +$0.16 | +$0.18 |
| Diluted EPS excluding certain items | **$1.76** | **$1.22** |

The items excluded in the current quarter were the $143 million pre-tax restructuring/impairment charge related to the Star India Transaction and $397 million pre-tax of TFCF and Hulu intangible asset amortization (including fair value step-up on film and TV costs). For comparison, reported diluted EPS grew 35% year-over-year, so excluding these items the growth was stronger at 44%. Note this is a non-GAAP measure, not directly comparable to GAAP diluted EPS.

flat_bm25.raw: Final answer: $1.76, up 44% from $1.22 in Q1 fiscal 2024.
